predictions.selection: Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens to win (money line)
predictions.text: Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens on the money line is our standout European basketball selection when Round 7 tips off at the Telekom Center in Athens on Thursday. Top of the 20-team EuroLeague table at 5-1 (+90 points differential, 528 scored against 438 conceded) behind guard Sylvain Francisco (15.8 ppg, 4.5 apg) and center Mathias Lessort (19.5 PIR, 6.5 rpg), Panathinaikos swept past Partizan 72-55 away before an 81-91 Round 6 setback against Hapoel Tel Aviv. Bottom-ranked Kosner Baskonia sit twentieth at 1-5 (-60 differential) following an 86-78 loss at Virtus Bologna, making the hosts clear favourites.

predictions.selection: Ottawa Senators to win (money line, incl. OT/SO)
predictions.text: Ottawa Senators on the two-way money line (including overtime and shootout) is the selection at Canadian Tire Centre. Off to a sharp 6-3-0 start through nine games behind goaltender Linus Ullmark's 6-1-0 record, 1.33 goals-against average, and .945 save percentage, Ottawa also get steady top-line production from Tim Stützle (six points across his last five outings). While 5-2-2 Florida bring dangerous offense from Matthew Tkachuk (11 points in five games) and Brady Tkachuk (six goals), Ottawa's superior .903 team save percentage against Florida's .884 tilts home ice firmly toward the Senators.
